name: The Memory Garden of Forgotten Toys
description: An enchanted garden where vintage toys bloom like flowers, with teddy bears sprouting flower petals and toy cars growing leaves, all glowing softly under a twilight sky filled with fireflies.
prompt: A magical garden at twilight where vintage toys have grown into beautiful flowering plants, teddy bears with rose petal fur, toy cars with leafy green branches, wooden trains with blooming flowers, soft golden fireflies floating in the air, warm nostalgic lighting, fairy tale atmosphere, highly detailed, dreamy color palette, fantasy illustration style
caption: Where forgotten playthings find new life in the most beautiful way... 🧸🌸
